description: This file defines types and functions for managing devices, including device pairing, token rotation, and revocation, within a UI context.

methods.name: loadDevices
methods.description: Loads the list of pending and paired devices from the server.

methods.name: approveDevicePairing
methods.description: Approves a device pairing request by requestId.

methods.name: rejectDevicePairing
methods.description: Rejects a device pairing request by requestId, with user confirmation.

methods.name: rotateDeviceToken
methods.description: Rotates the device token for a specified device and role, and prompts user to copy the new token.

methods.name: revokeDeviceToken
methods.description: Revokes a device token for a specified device and role, with user confirmation.
